# CodeSpeedTest

> > CodeSpeedTest is a specialized typing speed test platform designed for developers to measure and improve their coding speed across 500+ programming languages including Python, JavaScript, Java, C++, Rust, Go, and Apex.

The platform provides WPM (words per minute) tracking, accuracy metrics, and programming syntax-specific typing tests. It includes comprehensive learning resources with code examples for various languages, with particular focus on Salesforce development technologies like Apex, SOQL, and SOSL.

## Core Features

- [CodeSpeedTest – Coding & Typing Speed Test for Developers](https://codespeedtest.com): Homepage: coding speed test for developers in 500+ languages
- [Programming Syntax WPM Calculator](https://codespeedtest.com/programming-syntax-wpm): WPM calculator measuring code typing speed with accuracy metrics
- [Coding Speed Test Features – Code Accuracy, WPM & Faster Mode](https://codespeedtest.com/features): Features page: WPM tracking, accuracy metrics, 500+ languages support

## Programming Language Tutorials

- [Learn Apex – 10 Code Examples](https://codespeedtest.com/learn/apex): Apex tutorial with 10+ code examples for Salesforce development practice
- [Learn Fortran – 10 Code Examples](https://codespeedtest.com/learn/fortran): Fortran tutorial with 10+ examples for scientific computing practice
